note: Aurora Archipelago terrain on a 4-stud grid. Row r (north -> south), column c (west -> east): cell centre x = x0 + 4*c, z = z0 + 4*r. height = top surface y; 0 = void (no voxels: cloud floor). material = index into materials. water = water surface y (null = dry). Fill terrain voxels from y fill_min_y up to height with the cell material (Rock below the top 4 studs on cliffs), Water from height to water.
